stories.title: Add CoCu Completeness Validator Script
stories.description: Create automated script to validate that all required sections exist in each CoCu markdown file (header table, learning outcomes, assessment criteria, practical exercises, references, contact hours distribution). Generates compliance report per CoCu.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/validate_cocu_completeness.py checks for 8 required sections in each of 20 CoCu files
Reports missing sections with file path and section name (e.g. 'content/IT-020-3/01_CoCu-1-Computer-System-Set-up.md missing Practical Exercises')
Outputs summary: X/20 files complete, Y/20 require fixes

stories.title: Create Cross-Level Learning Outcome Consistency Checker
stories.description: Validate that Learning Outcomes (Knowledge 30%, Performance 70%) are aligned across L3→L4→L5. Ensure L4 builds on L3 foundations and L5 adds management layer. Detect contradictions or gaps in learning progression.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/validate_learning_outcome_progression.py parses Learning Outcome Matrix from each CoCu
Checks that L4 Knowledge outcomes reference L3 prerequisites (heuristic: shared terminology)
Outputs alignment report: 'L3 CoCu-1 → L4 CoCu-1: 8/10 outcomes aligned'

stories.title: Implement NOSS Compliance Scoring Dashboard
stories.description: Generate compliance score for each CoCu against 10-point NOSS checklist (bilingual content, contact hours math, assessment criteria format, practical exercises count, references present, equipment list, contact hour distribution %, learning outcomes split, section completeness, docx rendering). Output JSON report and HTML dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/generate_noss_compliance_report.py calculates 10-point compliance score per CoCu
Outputs JSON: {cocus: [{path: 'content/.../01.md', score: 9.5, gaps: [...]}]}
Generates HTML dashboard at output/noss_compliance_dashboard.html with bar charts per level

stories.title: Add Automated Spell and Grammar Validation for Bahasa Malaysia Content
stories.description: Validate Bahasa Malaysia sections in all CoCu files for common spelling errors and grammar issues. Use dictionary-based spell checker (python-hunspell) and simple n-gram grammar patterns. Flag errors by CoCu and section.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/validate_malay_grammar.py uses python-hunspell for Malay spell-checking
Reports errors as: 'content/IT-020-3/01.md line 47: Salah ejaan "pemprosesn" (should be "pemprosesan")'
Generate summary report: X spelling errors, Y grammar flags across all 20 CoCu files

stories.title: Create Assessment Rubric Generator from Criteria Sections
stories.description: Parse Assessment Criteria sections from each CoCu and auto-generate 4-level grading rubrics (Excellent/Competent/Developing/Not Yet). Output rubrics linked to Learning Outcomes and performance indicators.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/generate_assessment_rubrics.py extracts Assessment Criteria text blocks
Generates rubric for each criterion: {criterion: '...', excellent: '...', competent: '...', developing: '...', notyet: '...'}
Outputs to output/assessment_rubrics_L3_L4_L5.docx with tables formatted for instructor use

stories.title: Build Contact Hour Fairness Analyzer Across CoCu Files
stories.description: Analyze contact hour distribution (theoretical vs practical, knowledge vs performance) across all CoCu per level. Identify outliers and suggest rebalancing. Ensure 30%/70% knowledge/performance split is fair and achievable.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/analyze_contact_hours_fairness.py parses Contact Hour Distribution table from each CoCu
Calculates: L3_avg_knowledge_hours, L3_std_dev, then flags CoCu > 1 std dev as outlier
Outputs: 'L3 CoCu-1: 120 knowledge hours (high — average 95), consider reducing by 15-20 hours'

stories.title: Implement CoCu Difficulty Progression Validator for L3→L4→L5
stories.description: Validate that practical exercises increase in difficulty from L3 (foundational) → L4 (intermediate) → L5 (advanced/management). Check that prerequisites are met before advanced concepts. Flag exercises that are too easy/hard for their level.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/validate_exercise_difficulty_progression.py parses Practical Exercises sections from aligned CoCu across levels
Uses difficulty heuristic: word count of exercise, tool complexity, multi-step requirement, no. of dependencies
Outputs: 'L3→L4→L5 CoCu-1 exercise progression valid (increasing difficulty: 50→120→180 words)'

stories.title: Create Student Learning Path Generator Based on Competency Gaps
stories.description: Generate personalized learning sequences for students based on assessed competency gaps. Create micro-study guides that link CoCu content, practical exercises, and assessments. Output as markdown or HTML.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/generate_learning_path.py accepts student competency gaps JSON: {missing_competencies: [...]}
Outputs learning path markdown: 'Week 1: L3 CoCu-1 (8 hrs) → Practical 1.2 → Assessment → L4 CoCu-1 (prerequisite check passes)'
Include time estimates and success criteria per milestone

stories.title: Create NOSS Submission Package Generator for JPK
stories.description: Automate creation of complete JPK/MySPIKE submission package: bundle 3 textbooks + compliance reports + metadata. Generate submission checklist and validation certificate. Ready for regulatory filing.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/generate_jpk_submission_package.py bundles output/NOSS-IT-020-*.docx + validation reports + metadata.json
Outputs zip file: output/NOSS_IT020_JPK_Submission_YYYYMMDD.zip with structure: /textbooks/ /reports/ /metadata.json /CHECKLIST.txt
Metadata includes: compliance_score (target: ≥9.5), submission_date, validator_version, bilingual_validation_status

stories.title: Build CoCu Cross-Reference Indexer and Competency Map Visualization
stories.description: Index all competencies and learning outcomes across 20 CoCu files. Create cross-reference map showing: which CoCu teaches which competencies, competency prerequisites, and knowledge dependencies between levels. Output interactive graph or table.
acceptanceCriteria: Script at scripts/generate_competency_index.py parses Learning Outcome Matrix from all 20 CoCu
Creates bidirectional index: competency_id → {cocus: [...], prerequisite_competencies: [...], dependent_competencies: [...]}
Generates visualization at output/competency_map_L3_L4_L5.html (network graph or dependency diagram)
